narrative.overview: VayuPlan bridges public civic storytelling and high-precision environmental decision support through the visual grammar of an Indian atmospheric observatory strip-chart laid over a crisp daylight structural grid. Across both the public entry surface (/) and the AI-first operating workspace (/assistant), telemetry never floats as isolated decorative boxes; every number, curve, and Gemini synthesis anchors onto a calm graph-vellum drafting plane ruled by subtle construction hairlines (1px), disciplined elevation tiers, and high-contrast daylight ink. To replace the flat, boxed Stage 4 UI and make generative intelligence unmistakable, this system rejects dark-mode neon weather gauges, glassmorphism blur halos, nested card-in-card borders, and buried AI tabs. Instead, / speaks in Persuade mode with bold scale contrast and a live interactive city-sounding preview, while /assistant operates in Operate mode with an AI-synthesized Today's Smart Brief anchored at the top and a persistent right-hand Ask VayuPlan Copilot rail.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight Graph-Vellum Discipline: Cool atmospheric mineral canvas (#F7F8FA) paired with pure plotted sheets (#FFFFFF) and faint structural ruling (#DCE3EC).

Dual-Voice Editorial & Operational Typography: Bricolage Grotesque commands / hero storytelling and primary NAQI numerals, Schibsted Grotesk carries high-scanability UI and guidance copy, and JetBrains Mono (tabular-nums) handles sensor metrics, IST timestamps, and coordinate tags exclusively.
AI-First Spatial Hierarchy: Gemini AI synthesis (Today's Smart Brief + persistent Ask VayuPlan Copilot) occupies primary visual real estate on /assistant rather than hiding behind a secondary tab.
Scrubbable Strip-Chart Ergonomics: Smooth cubic diurnal modeling with shaded safe/peak zones, vertical hover/touch crosshairs, and leader-dot floating inspection tooltips.
WCAG AA Severity Integrity: Six CPCB NAQI categories combine high-contrast badges (>= 4.5:1), distinct icons, and explicit text labels.

rules.name: The Atmospheric Restraint Rule
rules.body: Atmospheric Cobalt (#1D4ED8) never decorates passive backgrounds or competes with CPCB severity badges; reserve it strictly for active focus, AI Copilot cues, and interactive chart scrubbers (<= 12% viewport saturation).

rules.name: The Color-Independent Severity Rule
rules.body: Pollution severity is never conveyed by color alone; every NAQI badge renders text category, numeric bounds, and its distinct semantic icon together.

rules.name: The Zero-Costume Mono Rule
rules.body: Never set headings, narrative paragraphs, or buttons in JetBrains Mono; monospace is strictly an instrument of precision for live readings, timestamps, units, and provenance metadata.

rules.name: The Anti-Jitter Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every animating or dynamically updated numeric value (AQI dial, hourly tooltip, commute CO2, character counter) carries .tabular-nums so numbers tick smoothly without horizontal shift.

rules.name: The Flat-Zero-Glow Rule
rules.body: Never apply zero-offset colored neon halos, blur glows, or >1px colored left/right accent borders on cards. Depth comes strictly from directional daylight shadows and tonal wells.

dos: Do keep Ask VayuPlan Copilot and Today's Smart Brief immediately visible on /assistant without requiring a tab switch.
Do enforce WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) contrast on all text, including muted telemetry labels (#525E70 minimum darkness on #FFFFFF/#F7F8FA) and all 6 CPCB NAQI severity tiers.
Do wrap all Framer Motion sequences in <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"> so prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables spatial transitions cleanly.
Do preserve AbortController race-condition protection on city/preset fetches and min-w-[...] inside overflow-x-auto containers for zero horizontal overflow at 375px.
donts: Don't render JetBrains Mono as decorative display/paragraph copy, or use dark-mode neon gradients, glassmorphism blur backdrops, or >1px colored left borders.
Don't bury / scenario launchers behind generic marketing claims; every preset card on / must derive from src/lib/presets.ts with zero hardcoded static AQI numbers.
Don't expose GEMINI_API_KEY, WAQI_API_TOKEN, or add third-party external CDN scripts that violate next.config.ts strict CSP.
